description: Reads a public website, brand book or pasted text and suggests Brand Kit fields: tone, voice words, words to use and avoid, audience, offers and sample posts. Use when the user wants to set up the brand voice from their site or existing copy. Not for saving changes (use update_brand_kit with the suggestions you keep). Returns suggestions only; nothing is saved. Team managers only; needs a plan with Brand Kit import, 5 imports per team per day.

brand_book_url.description: Public brand book or tone guide (HTML or PDF), e.g. "https://yourgym.com/brand.pdf". Not with text.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

text.description: Pasted brand text (about page, tone notes), max 10,000 characters. Use instead of url and brand_book_url.

url.description: Public website to read the brand from, e.g. "https://yourgym.com". Use with or instead of brand_book_url; not with text.

name: import_brand_kit
title: Suggest Brand Kit from a website
